headline: ICE 👮‍♂️💥 POPS Nurse Alex 🍑🩺 in Minneapolis ICE RAGE-FEST 🔥😡
text:

Minneapolis MELTDOWN 🍦🔥, Trump Deport DADDY 👑🍆 vs Nurse HERO 🩺🦸 – WHO YA GOT BETCHA?! 🎰😤
